summary.note: the four checks whose status string carries a parenthetical (V15, V16) count as PASS: the claim they test is 'does X behave as the label says', and the label is what fails

checks.claim: The code under audit is identified by hash and by which frozen protocol it belongs to
checks.evidence: working tree compared against both code manifests: v4 22/22 match, v3 11/19 match with 8 differing. Both config hashes recomputed as sha256(json.dumps(yaml.safe_load(cfg), sort_keys=True)) and equal to the recorded 1b47e0ed (v3) and 7834d0aa (v4)
checks.limit: clearing and reward-path files (dispatch_socp, rl_env, c2_reward, daily_reward_b, b1_daily_baseline, v2_cy_jn_env) are byte-identical in v3 and v4, so the clearing model description holds for both; the action, gate and reward-scale description is v4's

checks.claim: Every objective term is traceable to a source line
checks.evidence: objective_terms.csv: 14 rows, each with a file:line range and a config key. The set of accumulations in src/dispatch_socp.py (obj += / obj -= at 574, 584-596, 596-613, 618, and 92-98 in _add_independent_storage) is fully covered and no other statement touches obj
checks.limit: 9 active terms, 4 inactive terms, plus the independent-storage terminal credit

checks.claim: Every constraint is registered with indices, hardness, slack and meaning
checks.evidence: constraint_register.csv: 26 rows covering every addConstr / addQConstr / addVars call in src/dispatch_socp.py and src/dispatch_core.py that binds the clearing
checks.limit: three constraints are marked inactive together with the config key that disables them

checks.claim: Cycle cost coverage is complete across clearing, settlement, reward and baseline
checks.evidence: cycle_cost_dataflow.md: six real appearances and two absences, each cited to a line
checks.limit: the legacy two_settlement path omits cycle cost entirely; that is a gap in that path only, and it is not on the formal path

checks.claim: Any difference between window-terminal and day-terminal SOC handling is explained
checks.evidence: soc_mpc_terminal_audit.md sections 3-6. pins_terminal_soc gates on horizon_type only (src/dispatch_core.py:31-57); rl_env selects day_end at the last window (src/rl_env.py:961-963)

checks.claim: All inputs that were read are hashed
checks.evidence: input_manifest.json: 27 code files and 14 config / manifest / doc files hashed from bytes; 10 data files cited from the frozen manifest instead of read
checks.limit: hashing a data file would have read it, which the phase boundary forbids

checks.claim: Test, Holiday and H2 data and artifacts were not read
checks.evidence: no command in this phase opened any file under data/ or any run or snapshot tree; the only data hashes in the report are strings copied out of the v4 manifest
checks.limit: PASS by construction, not by observation

checks.claim: No formal source, config, manifest, checkpoint or historical report was modified
checks.evidence: git status --porcelain went from 65 entries at session start to 66; the single addition is reports/market_mechanism_audit/. The pre-existing modified and untracked entries are unchanged
checks.limit: no file outside the audit directory was written

checks.claim: No market was re-cleared and no training or optimizer step was executed
checks.evidence: no invocation of clear_market, solve_socp_opf_batch, run_truthful_day, settle_day, c2_reward or any trainer in this phase; every numeric statement is either a config constant or arithmetic on constants

checks.claim: Finite-difference verification of LMPs against the balance duals
checks.evidence: would require perturbing a demand or a quote and re-clearing
checks.limit: the phase boundary defers this to a separate future task; every LMP identity in this report is a dual-based derivation

checks.claim: The slack-bus LMP equals the external wholesale price
checks.evidence: derived from the C02 dual at b = 0 with p_grid as the balancing injection: Pi = -w_t * dt, so lmp = -Pi/dt = w_t

checks.claim: The magnitude of the spatial LMP spread relative to the external anchor
checks.evidence: needs a cleared day

checks.claim: The magnitude by which the ESS quotes change dispatch
checks.evidence: needs two clears differing only in one quote
checks.limit: the mechanism by which a quote enters the objective is PASS (src/dispatch_socp.py:584-586 and 92-93); the effect size is not established

checks.claim: The day-end terminal SOC pin in the last 4-period window is always feasible
checks.evidence: arithmetic: over 4 periods the reachable end SOC from a start s0 is [s0 - 0.2717, s0 + 0.23], so hitting 0.5 requires s0 in [0.27, 0.7717], while the SOC box is [0.10, 0.90] and nothing constrains the previous window
checks.limit: the failure path (fallback to the per-period engine at src/market.py:88 then 116-138) is traced; whether it occurred in a frozen run is NOT_TESTED because run logs are outside the read scope

checks.claim: The nodal re-solve loop changes the solution, as its name implies
checks.evidence: obj2 at src/dispatch_socp.py:663-703 is term-for-term identical to obj at 566-628 under the live config; max_change is 0 and the loop breaks after exactly one extra optimize. The claim tested is 'does it do what it says'; it does not
checks.limit: a degenerate tie between alternative optima could in principle return different duals on the second solve; not measured

checks.claim: The manifest settlement label describes the implemented settlement
checks.evidence: formal_training_config.yaml says settlement: two_settlement_ledger; two_settlement (src/market.py:21-51) has no caller on the formal path (grep: only src/run.py:221 and src/ui/sim_page.py:700/1137); the formal ledger is participant_payoff. The claim tested is 'does the label describe the implementation'; it does not

checks.claim: The observation contains no future realised price
checks.evidence: src/rl_env.py:546-552 comment plus the construction at 558-631: load and RE from forecasts, prices from history only, every price ratio divided by the frozen PRICE_REF_CNY_MWH. The repo carries a test named test_the_observation_ignores_prices_after_the_decision
checks.limit: that test was not executed in this phase

checks.claim: The multi-objective, exclusive-or binary, MPC, storage ramp and grid ramp mechanisms are inactive
checks.evidence: config/defaults.yaml: enable_multi_objective false, use_constraint_multi_obj false, exclusive_mode off, self_schedule false, every StorageSpec ramp field None, ramp_limit_mw_per_period None; each has a code gate cited in clearing_model_current.md section 4.2

checks.claim: A training reward is not a participant payoff, and neither is a clearing objective
checks.evidence: three distinct objects traced: clearing_objective = m.ObjVal (src/dispatch_socp.py:754); raw_profit = participant_payoff(...).total (src/rl_env.py:852-863); R_i = (G_policy - G_B1)/scale placed at block 23 (src/daily_reward_b.py:137-163)

checks.claim: Test and Holiday data stayed out of training under the audited protocol
checks.evidence: the v4 manifest records checks all_disjoint true, legacy_label_matches true, h2_sealed true and all_pass true, with boundaries test_evaluated false and holiday_evaluated false
checks.limit: this phase did not re-execute training_contract.py, so the claim rests on the recorded check results

not_verified.risk: every LMP identity here (slack = wholesale, marginal storage pricing, cycle cost inside the price) rests on dual algebra alone

not_verified.risk: the mechanism is established and the effect size is not, so no conclusion about whether the ESS actually exercise market power is supported

not_verified.reason: run logs and artifacts are outside the read scope

not_verified.item: the reconciliation identity CP + BC = wholesale*import + rent evaluated numerically
not_verified.risk: the identity is traced in code only

not_verified.item: whether the v3 formal runs were produced by the v3 pins
not_verified.reason: the working tree no longer matches 8 of the 19 v3 pins, and the v3 checkpoints were not inspected
not_verified.risk: any report describing a v3 run describes code that is no longer present in the tree; this audit makes no claim about those runs
